apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Credentials for the public API at /api/v1.
apiKeys.nameHint: What it is for — the automation or script that will use it.
apiKeys.shownOnce: This is the only time this token is shown. Everdue stores a hash of it and cannot show it again.
apiKeys.headerHint: Send it as the X-Api-Key header.
apiKeys.scopeNote: A key can read and write work, entities, reports and exports. It can never reach users, settings, channels, imports, keys or webhooks — whatever its actor’s role.
apiKeys.actorNote: Every write a key makes is recorded in the ledger under the person it acts as.

auth.lockedOut: This account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts.
auth.changePasswordHint: Your account needs a new password before you can continue.
auth.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.passwordMustDiffer: The new password must be different from the current one.
auth.externalFailed: That account cannot sign in here. Ask an administrator to create it first, or use your password.

board.title: My work
board.truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} items — pick a person to see the rest.

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.description: Credentials Everdue uses to reach people. Secrets are stored encrypted and never shown again.
channels.secretHint: Leave a secret blank to keep the stored one.
channels.testFailed: The test message could not be sent.
channels.whatsAppHint: WhatsApp can only send templates you have had approved by Meta. A type with no template name falls back to the person’s other channel.

checklist.title: Checklist
checklist.templateHint: Copied onto every occurrence when it is created. Editing it never changes occurrences that already exist.
checklist.blockedByProof: a photo or file is required
checklist.proofRequired: This responsibility requires a photo or file before it can be completed.

common.showingOf: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Refine the search or filters to see the rest.
common.name: Name

departments.title: Departments
departments.hint: The team that executes the work.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.bannerHint: This workspace holds invented data for demonstration. Nothing in it is real work.
demo.stateOn: This workspace is filled with six months of invented history so the dashboards, reports and insights have something to show. Turn it off to clear everything and start using Everdue for real.
demo.stateOff: This workspace holds your real work. Turning demo mode on will replace all of it with six months of invented history.
demo.warning: Both turning demo mode on and turning it off delete everything in this workspace first. There is no undo. Take a backup of the data directory before you continue.
demo.confirmLedger: Every work item, occurrence, responsibility, entity and department — the whole ledger, misses included.
demo.confirmUsers: Every user account except your own. Your colleagues will have to be invited again.
demo.confirmFiles: Every attachment, including the files on disk.
demo.confirmIrreversible: None of it can be recovered except from a backup.
demo.willSeed: Six months of demo history will then be written, with demo accounts that all share the password
demo.passwordHint: Re-entered because holding an open session is not proof that you are the one at the keyboard.
demo.turnedOn: Demo mode is on: {{responsibilities}} responsibilities and {{occurrences}} occurrences were created.
demo.turnedOff: Demo mode is off. {{workItems}} work items were deleted; the workspace is empty and ready for real use.

digest.title: Manager digest
digest.hint: A summary e-mail of what was missed, what is due and what is blocked.

entities.title: Entities
entities.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this entity? Its history stays.
entities.guardrail: Entities are references — name, type, active. Nothing else belongs here.

entityFields.title: Custom fields
entityFields.description: Extra reference values on an entity — an account manager, a serial number.
entityFields.fieldTypeHint: Cannot be changed later: every stored value would become invalid.
entityFields.guardrail: These are display-only references. Nothing filters, sorts or reports on them — Everdue manages work, not business data.
entityFields.deleteNote: Deleting a field leaves stored values behind; they are ignored and dropped the next time the entity is saved.

errors.conflict: That action is not allowed right now.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

help.title: Help
help.description: How Everdue works, screen by screen.
help.unavailable: This topic is not available in your language yet.

imports.title: Import from CSV
imports.description: Bring a client list or a set of open tasks in from a spreadsheet.
imports.fileHint: Comma- or semicolon-separated. Exported from Excel is fine.
imports.entitiesHint: Customers, suppliers, equipment and departments, with their custom fields.
imports.workItemsHint: One-off tasks only. Recurring responsibilities are created in the app — a recurrence rule does not survive a spreadsheet cell.
imports.detected: Detected {{delimiter}} as the separator, {{encoding}} encoding, {{rows}} data rows.
imports.previewHasErrors: {{count}} of the previewed rows cannot be imported as mapped.
imports.skippedNote: Skipped rows already exist. An import creates or skips; it never overwrites.

insights.calendarDays: Calendar days, nights and weekends included
insights.complianceEmpty: No period has ended in this window yet.
insights.complianceIntro: Completed on time out of every period that has ended. A late completion counts as a miss.
insights.concentrationEmpty: No work was completed in this window.
insights.concentrationIntro: How much completed work each entity accounts for. Counts of work items, not hours.
insights.holdAgingEmpty: Nothing was on hold in this window.
insights.partialHint: The last point is the period still in progress.
insights.rateNothingDue: Nothing was due in this window.
insights.rateWithheld: Too few periods to show a percentage — the count is beside it.
insights.reliabilityAttribution: Attributed to the current owner of each item.
insights.reliabilityEmpty: Nobody has finished a period in this window yet.
insights.reliabilityExternal: External waits are included in the rate and shown separately.
insights.reliabilityIntro: Per person, over recurring work only: a one-off task can never be missed.
insights.unlinkedTotal: {{count}} completed items are not linked to an entity
insights.windowHint: The newest column is the period still in progress.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.preferencesHint: The bell always works. A channel is how a message also reaches you outside Everdue.
notifications.channelHint: Only channels this installation has configured are offered.
notifications.noChannelsConfigured: No external channel is configured on this installation yet.
notifications.telegramHint: Open the bot and send it the code below. Everdue never needs an inbound connection.
notifications.telegramLinked: Telegram is linked. Your alerts arrive in that chat.
notifications.telegramNoBotUsername: Send the code below to your organisation’s Everdue bot.
notifications.telegramExpires: The code expires in 15 minutes and can be used once.

typeHint.Assigned: Somebody gave you a task or a responsibility.
typeHint.DueToday: A daily reminder of what is due today.
typeHint.Missed: One of your occurrences went missed.
typeHint.Mentioned: Somebody mentioned you in a comment.
typeHint.PutOnHold: Somebody put your work on hold.

reassign.futureHint: Every future occurrence will belong to the new owner automatically.
reassign.applyToWorkable: Also move the occurrences already open
reassign.applyToWorkableHint: Includes missed ones — they still need completing late.
reassign.historyKept: History stays where it is: every move is recorded with who made it.

recurrence.clampNote: A day that does not exist in a short month falls on that month's last day.

reports.neglectEmpty: No entity has been left this long.
reports.drillThrough: Show the work behind this number

responsibility.title: Responsibilities
responsibility.pauseHint: Periods that fall entirely inside the pause are skipped, not missed.
responsibility.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this responsibility? Existing occurrences stay in the ledger.
responsibility.requireChecklistHint: Required steps must be ticked. Enforced by the server, not just the screen.
responsibility.requireChecklistNeedsItems: Add at least one checklist step first.
responsibility.requireAttachment: Require a photo or file before completing
responsibility.requireAttachmentHint: Proof of completion. Any allowed attachment satisfies it.
responsibility.completionRulesNotRetroactive: Applies from the next completion. Nothing already completed is reopened.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.name: Organization name
settings.timeZoneHint: All periods and due dates are computed in this zone.
settings.digestHint: The digest is sent to active administrators at this local hour.
settings.reminderHint: Local hour the "due today" reminders go out. Later than the digest by default.
settings.canUseSystemChannels: May use the system’s channel credentials
settings.canUseSystemChannelsHint: On for a self-hosted install, where the system and this organisation are the same operator. WhatsApp is never shared, whatever this says.

users.title: Users
users.resetPasswordHint: The user will be asked to choose a new password at their next sign-in.
users.noSelfService: There is no self-service registration: an administrator creates every account.
users.whatsAppNumberHint: International format, e.g. +573001112233. WhatsApp has no linking flow, so you enter it — make sure this person has agreed to be messaged there.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Everdue posts to your URL when work changes. Outbound only — no inbound endpoint needed.
webhooks.urlHint: https, unless a plain-http receiver has been allowed in configuration.
webhooks.reEnableHint: Turning this back on resets the failure count.
webhooks.failedRecently: {{count}} failed delivery(ies) in the last 24 hours.
webhooks.deliveryNote: Delivery is at-least-once: a retry reuses the same webhook-id header, which is what lets your receiver deduplicate.
webhooks.secretShownOnce: This is the only time this secret is shown. Everdue keeps only an encrypted copy.
webhooks.secretVerifyHint: Verify each request with HMAC-SHA256 over "{webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{body}" — see docs/api.md.

workItem.title: Title
workItem.occurrenceRescheduleHint: An occurrence can only move inside its own period.
workItem.cancelOnlyOneOff: Only one-off tasks can be cancelled. Pause or deactivate the responsibility instead.
